newsitem.title: USA: AT&T sets final stock distribution for Lucent.
newsitem.headline: AT&T sets final stock distribution for Lucent.

text.p: AT&T Corp. said Wednesday it will distribute 0.324084 share of Lucent Technologies Inc. for each AT&T share outstanding, finalising the spinoff of the communications, software and microelectronics subsidiary.
The distribution is scheduled for Sept. 30. As of Tuesday night, AT&T had 1.6 billion shares oustanding.
It will result in AT&T shareholders receiving about 82.4 percent of Lucent's outstanding common shares. The other 17.6 percent of Lucent outstanding shares was sold to the public in April.
Shareholders will receive stock certificates for whole shares and cash payments for fractional shares, the company said.
Lucent's stock rose 37.5 cents to $40.75, and AT&T gained 87.5 cents to $57.875 on the New York Stock Exchange in early afternoon trading.
